summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the filing of a prospectus supplement on Form S-3ASR to register the resale of 99,105 shares of common stock by certain stockholders who acquired the shares in connection with the company's acquisition of World View Enterprises Inc. on April 1, 2026. The shares are exempt under Regulation D. A legal opinion from Snell & Wilmer L.L.P. is attached. This is a routine securities registration matter, not a special situation. No actionable deal terms or strategic event are involved.
